title: Painted Power - Pictos Effect & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Painted Power in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - what this Pictos does and exactly where to find it.

facts.label: Location
facts.value: Defeat The Paintress at the top of The Monolith

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Painted Power is a Pictos in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. Effect: Damage can exceed 9,999.

sections.title: How to Get Painted Power
sections.content: Location: Defeat The Paintress at the top of The Monolith.

sections.title: Is It Worth Equipping?
sections.content: Pictos unlock a Lumina after four battles, so equipping it once is enough to keep the effect permanently available for the Lumina cost.
